title: Locate the nonlinear mapping responsible for behaviorally relevant reaching dynamics
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Joint one-step-ahead prediction of neural activity and 2D cursor position/velocity in Figure 6h-i, comparing nonlinear mapping locations.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Joint one-step-ahead prediction of neural activity and 2D cursor position/velocity in Figure 6h-i, comparing nonlinear mapping locations.

Source-paper comparison for Behavior decoding mean CC jointly assessed with neural self-prediction mean CC on the Figure 6i frontier: Pearson CC separately for each behavior/neural channel: covariance divided by the product of standard deviations; arithmetic channel mean gives each fold score. Higher is better in both coordinates.
success_criteria: Recover and pin numeric published Figure 6i results plus exact seven-session, 32-electrode, preprocessing and original temporal-fold identity.

Reproduce the author comparison with both neural and behavior predictions, original nonlinear-location alternatives, the complete latent-dimension search and training-only selection; reconcile local scorer deviations.

Freeze a candidate and predeclared meaningful joint-performance and uncertainty rules before final predictions; improve over the recovered paper comparator, not merely the fully linear/local baseline.

Retain complete source cases and both coordinates. A smaller subset, held-session split, causal-filter profile, improved p-value or matching the original nonlinear-locus conclusion is not same-task superiority.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
